classification.difficultyReason: Reverse the familiar representation by interpreting coefficients as cup counts and constants as loose marbles, then drawing each model.

content.prompt: $x$ represents the number of marbles in a cup. Draw a diagram to represent:

answer.short: Four cups, each containing $x$ marbles, and two loose marbles.
answer.worked: $4x$ represents four cups containing $x$ marbles each; $+2$ represents two loose marbles.

spec.description: Four cups in a horizontal row followed by two loose marbles; x inside each cup identifies its contents.
spec.mathematics: Four groups of x marbles plus two individual marbles.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete answer diagram appears only in answer editions.

answer.short: Seven cups, each containing $x$ marbles, and five loose marbles.
answer.worked: $7x$ represents seven cups containing $x$ marbles each; $+5$ represents five loose marbles.

spec.description: Seven cups in a horizontal row followed by five loose marbles arranged in two rows; x inside each cup identifies its contents.
spec.mathematics: Seven groups of x marbles plus five individual marbles.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete answer diagram appears only in answer editions.
